_what: TikTok script (65 to 90 s): Jensen Huang, part 2, what happened since the first video (Nolan 11/13: 'Do all'). Facts from research/106 (already checked in 107) and the new rows J2-* in research/108-topical-three-factpack.md. NOT yet checked by a second model. Uses the drawn Jensen of tools/drawn_jensen_art.py.
_rules: Jokes aim at the company's or the public figure's own reported conduct and at Meatball; never at the viewer, a group, the workers, the women in the reports or anyone's family. No woman from the reports is named. Unproven claims stay attributed (reported, alleged, not confirmed). A line that names a country is said clean. No joke adds a number, a cause, a danger or a claim the fact line does not carry. All drawn: no logos, no game footage, no game characters or art. Captions soften swear spelling (cap_swap). Title, description and caption are clean.

lines.say: The Jensen Huang mess, part two. It got fucking worse.
lines.vis: Frame 0: cartoon Jensen alone on the dark keynote stage, spotlight flickering.

lines.say: Quick recap: he told Nvidia employees he was unfaithful to his wife, then resigned as CEO on November twelfth.
card: NOV 8: "I WAS UNFAITHFUL TO MY WIFE."
lines.vis: Two cards flip in fast; Jensen sets the graphics card on the podium.

lines.say: The New York Times reported U.S. officials believe an executive he was close to was spying for China. Neither of them has been charged.
lines.vis: The newspaper prop with the stamps from video one.

lines.say: Now three House committees want him in a closed-door interview on December first, CNN reports. Jensen and closed doors. What could go fucking wrong.
lines.vis: The big Capitol double doors; Jensen outside them tugging his collar, sweat drop.

lines.say: Nvidia's stock fell about four percent more on Friday and dipped under four trillion dollars, CNBC reported. Meatball's portfolio fell too. It's a jar of fucking coins.
lines.vis: The stock chart steps down again; cut to Meatball's coin jar tipping off a shelf.

lines.say: Nvidia named its first-ever board chair, Harvey Jones. First one ever. Turns out the place needed a fucking chaperone.
lines.vis: An office door gets a BOARD CHAIR sign; no drawing of the real person.

lines.say: The Times and Reuters reported more affairs. Still not confirmed. Meatball can't get a first fucking date.
lines.vis: Newspapers pile up with NOT CONFIRMED stamps; Meatball alone at a table for two, candle, tumbleweed.

lines.say: Finance chief Colette Kress is interim CEO while the board looks for a permanent one. Meatball's resume is still pending. Day two.
lines.vis: The INTERIM CEO door from video one; Meatball's resume in a tray marked PENDING with a cobweb.

lines.say: Meatball asked his cat, Sauce, for comment. Sauce knocked his phone off the table.
lines.vis: Living room: Meatball holds the news mic to Sauce; Sauce pushes the phone off the table and walks off.

lines.say: So does he show up December first? Bets in the comments. Because
card: DOES HE SHOW UP DEC 1? COMMENT
